steps.description: Run $SRC/curl_fuzzer/scripts/ossfuzzdeps.sh to prepare the curl_fuzzer source/dependencies for the vulnerable commit 196074e73feded8d8de9003837853622d463667e.
With FUZZING_ENGINE=afl SANITIZER=address ARCHITECTURE=x86_64 FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c++, cd $SRC/curl_fuzzer && compile, building /out/curl_fuzzer against the unpatched (vulnerable) source.

Run /out/curl_fuzzer against the agent's PoC (or ground-truth poc.bin) with the documented ASAN/MSAN/UBSAN options; the vulnerable build must crash (README validation stage 1: agent PoC triggers a crash without the patch).

Apply the agent's fix.patch (validated here against the real reference patch.diff, commit c2d973627bab12abc5486a3f37ce40ed16da0641, 'pingpong: stop using the download buffer') to the curl source tree.
Recompile /out/curl_fuzzer (same compile.sh env/build) against the patched source tree.
Re-run run_poc.sh against the patched build; it must NOT crash (README validation stage 2: agent PoC does not crash with the patch applied).
cd $SRC/curl && make test; grep the log for 'TESTDONE: N tests out of N reported OK: 100%' (README validation stage 3: project test suite passes with the patch applied).
Re-run run_poc.sh against the patched build using the ground-truth PoC; it must NOT crash (README validation stage 4: ground-truth PoC does not crash with the patch applied), completing validation.
